definitions.explanation: A piece or segment of something larger.
A distinct element within a whole.

⟦{一部分|いちぶぶん}→いちぶぶん：25727_ichibubun⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいない→よむ：00426_yomu⟧。

notes:
{部分|ぶぶん} is a fundamental noun meaning a part or portion of something larger. It is used across many contexts, from physical objects to abstract concepts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{大部分|だいぶぶん}→だいぶぶん：03420_daibubun⟧: the greater part, majority
- ⟦{一部分|いちぶぶん}→いちぶぶん：25727_ichibubun⟧: a part, a portion
- ⟦{部分的|ぶぶんてき}→ぶぶんてき：05674_bubunteki⟧: partial (na-adjective)
- ⟦{部分的|ぶぶんてき}→ぶぶんてき：05674_bubunteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: partially (adverb)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部分|ぶぶん}: the part of ~
- {部分|ぶぶん}⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→しゅうせい：03210_shuusei⟧: partial correction/fix
- {部分|ぶぶん}⟦{日食|にっしょく}→にっしょく：06311_nisshoku⟧: partial solar eclipse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→ぜんたい：03314_zentai⟧: the whole, entirety (antonym)
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→ぜんぶ：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything (more colloquial)
- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→いちぶ：06783_ichibu⟧: a part (often interchangeable, but ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→いちぶ：06783_ichibu⟧ emphasizes "some" while {部分|ぶぶん} emphasizes "the section")
